facts: MotoPass supports 10 languages: English, Spanish, French, Portuguese, Chinese, Arabic, Swahili, German, Hindi, and Japanese.
The i18n system uses a context-based approach with I18nProvider wrapping the entire app and useI18n() hook for components.
Language preference is stored in localStorage under 'motopass-lang' and defaults to 'system' which auto-detects from the browser.
Browser language detection uses navigator.languages and navigator.language with prefix matching (e.g. 'en-US' matches 'en').
Arabic is the only RTL (right-to-left) language in the current set — the system automatically sets document.dir to 'rtl' when Arabic is active.
Each route can have its own language preference stored in localStorage under 'motopass-lang-by-route', allowing per-page language overrides.
Recent language selections are tracked (up to 3) in localStorage under 'motopass-recent-langs' for quick switching.
The translation system uses a flat key structure with dot notation (e.g. 'nav.pitch', 'programs.title', 'vault.empty').
Translation keys are defined as a TypeScript union type (TranslationKey) for type safety — missing keys cause compile errors.
When a translation key is missing in the active language, the system falls back to English ('en') translation.
In development mode, missing translation keys log a console warning: '[i18n] Missing translation key: ...'
The formatT() helper supports variable interpolation in translations using {variable} syntax (e.g. '{count} jurisdictions').
Translation completeness varies by language: English and Spanish have full coverage, other languages have partial coverage with English fallback.
The Languages array includes metadata for each language: code, flag emoji, display name, native name, and text direction.
Language switcher is available in the navigation bar with keyboard shortcut Cmd+L (Mac) or Ctrl+L (Windows).
The LanguageProvider sets both document.documentElement.lang and document.documentElement.dir on every language change.
Route-level language persistence means a user can view /programs in Spanish and /vault in French if they set per-route preferences.
Translation dictionaries are imported as modules and merged: each language spreads English as base then overrides with its own keys.
Page-level translation keys are batched in pageKeys.ts and merged into the main dictionaries per language.
The i18n system is designed for progressive translation — new features ship with English first, other languages follow.

translation_categories.navigation: nav.* keys — top bar, menu, language switcher, breadcrumbs
translation_categories.pitch: pitch.* keys — landing page hero, features, pillars, products, FAQ, CTA
translation_categories.programs: programs.* keys — program explorer, filters, presets, table/card views
translation_categories.vault: vault.* keys — document stamping, proof cards, education, how-it-works
translation_categories.apply: apply.* keys — application form, gates, success state, document attachment
translation_categories.agents: agents.* keys — agent grid, office hours, Paige, deal rooms
translation_categories.dashboard: dashboard.* keys — alerts inbox, document registry, welcome
translation_categories.compare: compare.* keys — side-by-side matrix, synergy, diff view
translation_categories.simulator: simulator.* keys — stack builder, metrics, saved stacks
translation_categories.portfolio: portfolio.* keys — saved programs, stats, Compliance Clock
translation_categories.btcmap: btcmap.* keys — merchant directory, density, cache, directions
translation_categories.distressed: distressed.* keys — marketplace, lanes, filters, bookmarks
translation_categories.verify: verify.* keys — hash generation, OTS paste, batch verify, Nostr announce
translation_categories.profile: profile.* keys — user profile, stamped documents
translation_categories.modal: modal.* keys — program detail modal tabs and content
translation_categories.common: common.* keys — shared UI text (cancel, retry, close, copied)
translation_categories.errors: errors.* keys — error boundaries and load failures
translation_categories.layout: layout.* keys — skip-to-content, footer, demo badge

storage_keys.motopass-lang-by-route: Per-route language overrides (JSON map of path → LangPreference)
storage_keys.motopass-recent-langs: Recently used languages (array of up to 3 LangCodes)

honesty_rules: Always respond in the user's current language — detect from context or ask.
Translation coverage varies — never promise that a specific page is fully translated in all 10 languages.
The 'system' language setting auto-detects from the browser — explain this to users who ask why the language changed.
Per-route language overrides are advanced behavior — most users only need the global language setting.
Arabic is the only RTL language — mention this if a user asks about text direction.
Missing translations fall back to English — if a user sees English text in another language, it means that key hasn't been translated yet.
Language preferences persist in localStorage — clearing browser data resets language to system default.
The language switcher keyboard shortcut is Cmd+L (Mac) / Ctrl+L (Windows) — share this for quick switching.

member_scripts.how_to_change_language: Click the language indicator in the top navigation bar (or press Cmd+L on Mac / Ctrl+L on Windows) to open the language picker. Select your preferred language — it applies instantly across the entire site.
member_scripts.why_is_text_in_english: Some pages may show English text if the translation for that section hasn't been completed yet in your language. The system always falls back to English for missing translations. Full translations are available in English, Spanish, and French.
member_scripts.what_is_system_language: When set to 'System', MotoPass auto-detects your language from your browser settings (e.g. if your browser is set to Japanese, the site shows Japanese). You can override this by picking a specific language.
member_scripts.does_rtl_work: Yes — Arabic is fully supported with right-to-left (RTL) text direction. The entire layout flips automatically when Arabic is selected.
member_scripts.can_i_mix_languages: Yes! Each page can have its own language. For example, you can view /programs in Spanish and /vault in French. Your per-page preferences are saved automatically.
member_scripts.how_many_languages: MotoPass currently supports 10 languages: English, Spanish, French, Portuguese, Chinese, Arabic, Swahili, German, Hindi, and Japanese. English, Spanish, and French have the most complete translations.
member_scripts.what_about_new_languages: New languages are added progressively. When a new language is added, it starts with core navigation and page titles, with other sections filled in over time. English always serves as the fallback.
member_scripts.where_are_translations_stored: Translations are stored in the source code (src/i18n/translations.ts) and loaded at build time. Your language preference is stored in your browser's localStorage — it never leaves your device.
